runs.answer: McIlroy did NOT win the tournament in Dubai on 15 Nov 2026: Tyrrell Hatton won the DP World Tour Championship by five shots on -15 after a closing 66, with McIlroy second on -10 (bogey-free 67). What McIlroy won was the season-long Race to Dubai for an eighth time, equalling Colin Montgomerie's record — and that is the trophy he tearfully dedicated to his father, Gerry. Asked about his dad, McIlroy said Gerry had been in hospital for two months after a double lung transplant at the end of September, and told BBC: "He said to me: 'Go win The Race to Dubai'. runs.title: Ronaldinho's Ravenna comeback: the details
runs.prompt: Football legend Ronaldinho, now 46, has reportedly made a playing comeback for Italian club Ravenna. Find out from a source that is not paywalled: when his first appearance was or will be, what role he played, and what the club has said. Start from Ravenna's official site and an Italian sports outlet.
runs.answer: Ronaldinho's first appearance was on Sunday 15 November 2026 at 17:30 at the Stadio Benelli, in Ravenna's Serie C (girone B) derby against Forlì, which Ravenna won 2-0 (Donati, Rabbi). He was a starter ("titolare") and played the entire first half (~45 minutes) before coming off to a standing ovation. His role was a free-roaming attacking one: coach Andrea Mandorlini said "Giocherà dall'inizio... Ronaldinho farà quello che si sente," and Tuttosport explained he would play either as a trequartista in a 4-3-1-2 or as a wide forward in a 4-3-3, with Mandorlini willing to change shape to accommodate him. runs.title: Pick the clearest Nations League roundup

runs.answer: Pick: BBC Sport — its Scores & Fixtures page (bbc.com/sport/football/scores-fixtures) is the only candidate that loaded as fully readable, non-paywalled HTML and listed every Nations League game in one place: Belgium v Italy, France v Turkey, Croatia v Czech Republic and Spain v England (all 19:45), plus completed results elsewhere (Belarus 0-2 Albania, Finland 7-2 San Marino, Cyprus 1-4 Montenegro, Latvia 0-0 Armenia). For a written narrative roundup once the games finish, BBC's match reports/live page plus Al Jazeera's Spain v England blog are the readable options, but today's one-stop results overview is BBC's scores page.
